6: No gambling or loud and boisterous or disorderly conduct shall be permitted in any pool or pool and billiard room or bowling alley. (Ord of 12-11-72, Ch. IX {23).
7: Any proprietor or his clerk or employee violating any provisions of the preceding section shall be guilty of a misdemeanor. (Ord. of 12-11-72, Ch. IX {24).
8: When it comes to the knowledge of the mayor and council that any person licensed to keep a pool or pool and billiard room or bowling alley in the city has violated or permitted to be violated any of the rules or ordinances of the city relating to his business, the mayor and council shall declare his license revoked. If the said person shall have been convicted of such violation in the recorder’s court, the license may be revoked without his being further heard. In other cases he shall be given an opportunity to be heard in his defense. Should any such person carry on his business after the license has been revoked he shall be guilty of a misdemeanor. (Ord. Of 12-11-72, Ch. IX {25).
12: In addition to or instead of a penalty by fine or imprisonment, any violation of the provisions of this article shall subject the license issued to the operator of an establishment to be revoked by the mayor and council. (Ord. of 1-10-77, {3).
14: Any establishment with amusement and gaming devices and machines for operation, which establishment is located within five hundred (500) feet of a church, shall close at least one hour before and at least one hour after morning and evening church services on each Sunday hereafter. (Ord. Of 1-10-77, {2).
